reason: Edge is purely intraday scalping/day trading (15min-8h) with speed/size on short timeframes and short bias; no daily-bar rules or US stock swing rules given.

universe.description: multiple instruments including bonds/indices via retail platform

setup.rule: look for volatility spike or breakout from range/narrative shift
setup.quote: I'm looking for the market to make a directional shift... something to break out of the trend

setup.rule: fade or follow based on two entry styles
setup.quote: I either follow the market or I fade what I see

entry.rule: enter on price action to predetermined levels with size
entry.quote: I know if a market hits certain extremes based upon my levels

stop.rule: mental/close-all button; no hard stops while watching
stop.quote: I don't put stops in cuz I'm always watching the markets

exits.rule: take profit quickly on scalp; hold up to 8h on day trade
exits.quote: when I'm a scalper, I try and take the profit the first time it is offered to me

sizing.rule: use large size on short holds, smaller on longer holds; scale with account wins
sizing.quote: the shorter the time I'm in for a trade, the bigger size I'm using

market_filter.rule: ignore most news/narrative; watch price reaction only
market_filter.quote: I'm much more concerned about how the market reacts

ambiguities.issue: no mention of US stocks or daily bars
